news.title: Nokia: How a forgotten stock from Finland doubled investors wealth in AI comeback story
news.summary: Nokia shares have doubled in 2026 as investors increasingly view the company as an AI infrastructure player. Strong cloud and AI orders, broker upgrades and growing data-centre demand have boosted optimism, though sustained hyperscaler spending remains critical to its long-term growth outlook.

news.title: Vedanta Power Q1 update: Sales rise 38% on Meenakshi boost, Sakti shutdown weighs
news.summary: Vedanta Power reported a 38% year-on-year rise in Q1 power sales, driven by a sharp jump in Meenakshi Energy output. Sequential performance declined due to lower generation at some plants, while Sakti Thermal Plant remained shut after a boiler blast, impacting overall volumes during the quarter.

news.title: Pragyawan Technologies files DRHP with Sebi for Rs 400 crore IPO
news.summary: Pragyawan Technologies has filed its DRHP with SEBI for an IPO comprising a Rs 400 crore fresh issue and an OFS of 15 million shares. The company will use fresh issue proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes, strengthening its diversified technology and infrastructure business.

news.title: Kusumgar IPO price band fixed at Rs 398–419; Rs 650-crore issue opens July 8, GMP at 33%
news.summary: Kusumgar has set its IPO price band at Rs 398–419 for a Rs 650-crore offer for sale, opening July 8. The issue has a grey market premium of about 33%, signalling strong demand. The company has reported steady revenue and profit growth, supported by a diversified industrial fabric portfolio.

news.title: Atharva Polyplast IPO allotment date likely today. GMP, steps to check share allotment status online on BSE, MUFG Intime
news.summary: Atharva Polyplast's IPO allotment is expected today, with shares allocated proportionally to retail investors due to high oversubscription. The IPO, valued at ₹27 crore, attracted 10.74 times bids. Refunds for unsuccessful applicants will begin on July 6, 2025, with listings on July 7.

news.title: Aswath Damodaran predicts this for the future of AI: The next Amazon won't be Nvidia or OpenAI
news.summary: Damodaran believes AI will neither drastically eliminate jobs nor be a fleeting trend. He predicts it will enhance productivity while replacing certain roles. For investors, the lesson is that potential long-term AI winners might not yet be obvious, as seen in past technology revolutions.

news.title: Top Gainers & Losers on 3 July: Zensar Tech, HFCL, IndusInd Bank, Muthoot Finance, Lupin among top gainers
news.summary: The Indian stock market rose on July 3 before retreating as profit-taking emerged. The Nifty 50 closed up 0.40%, while the Sensex gained 0.35%. Realty led gains, but PSU Banks, Auto, and Metal sectors fell. Technology stocks showed signs of recovery amid easing rate hike concerns.
